UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user profile with isolated privacy settings and optional verified phone number.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated user.

displayName.description: Display name shown in multiplayer matches.

verifiedPhoneNumber.description: Optional verified E.164 phone number, isolated to owner.

contactDiscoveryEnabled.description: Whether optional contact discovery is enabled.

serverMatchingConsent.description: Whether informed consent for server-side contact matching is granted.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

Room.title: Room
Room.description: Real-time online multiplayer game room synchronized via Firestore.

hostUid.description: UID of the player who created the room (plays X).

hostName.description: Display name of the host player.

guestUid.description: UID of the joining player (plays O), empty string while waiting.

guestName.description: Display name of the guest player.

winningCells.description: Indices (0-8) of the winning line if won.

hostScore.description: Number of rounds won by host (X).

guestScore.description: Number of rounds won by guest (O).

draws.description: Number of drawn rounds in this room.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when room was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when room was last updated.

GameRecord.title: GameRecord
GameRecord.description: Synced match record owned by a specific authenticated user.

gameId.description: Unique identifier for the game record.

userId.description: Owner UID of this game record.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when game was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when game was updated.

ConsentRecord.title: ConsentRecord
ConsentRecord.description: Explicit privacy and contact discovery consent audit record.

userId.description: Authenticated UID of the consenting user.

policyVersion.description: Semantic version of the privacy policy accepted.

localContactsGranted.description: Whether Android READ_CONTACTS permission and local reading consent are active.

serverMatchingGranted.description: Whether separate opt-in consent for server-side matching is active.

grantedAt.description: Server timestamp when consent was granted.

revokedAt.description: Optional server timestamp when consent was revoked.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest consent update.

DiscoveryBatch.title: DiscoveryBatch
DiscoveryBatch.description: User-isolated metadata record of privacy-preserving HMAC token batches submitted for contact matching.

tokenCount.description: Number of normalized E.164 tokens in the batch (bounded).

tokenDigests.description: Bounded list of client-blinded token digests (max 50 per batch).

policyVersion.description: Policy version under which batch was submitted.

/users/{uid}.description: Private user profile and privacy settings document.

/consents/{uid}.description: Explicit user consent records for contact discovery.

/users/{uid}/discoveryBatches/{batchId}.description: User-owned contact discovery token batches subject to retention and deletion.
